layout.phone_prompt_title: Want to add your phone number?
layout.phone_prompt_body: It's optional — only needed if you want to use the WhatsApp bot (so you can reply "In"/"Out" on mixes). You can always add it later from your Profile.
landing.hero_description: No more spreadsheets or lost results. Create games, join mixes, and track rankings.
landing.features_heading: Everything your group needs, in one app
landing.whatsapp_bot_description: Reply "In" or "Out" on your WhatsApp group and alinho takes care of the rest.
landing.feature_games_description: Create games with date, time, and location. Join solo or with a partner. The rest is up to the group.
landing.feature_rankings_description: Wins, win rate, and points calculated automatically with each result.
landing.feature_community_description: See who's in the group, each player's level, and who you've played with.
landing.feature_clubs_description: Information about the clubs where your group plays, all in one place.
landing.feature_private_games_descriptio: Create invite-only games for when you don't need the whole group.
landing.step_1_description: Sign up with Google or email. Takes less than a minute.
landing.step_2_description: Join an open game solo or with a partner. Or create one if you're a group admin.
landing.step_3_description: Submit the result at the end and watch the group ranking update in real-time.
landing.steps_heading: Three steps and you're in the game
landing.closing_cta_heading: Ready to lineup for your next mix?
